metadata.title: Mohamed Ayman | Full-Stack Developer
metadata.description: Mohamed Ayman is a Full-Stack Developer and Computer Science student focused on building modern web applications.

heroBody: I'm a Computer Science student and Full-Stack Developer who enjoys building modern web applications. I work with React, Next.js, Node.js, and Express.js to create smooth user experiences and reliable backend systems. I enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into products that people can use.
aboutParagraphs: I'm Mohamed Ayman, a Full-Stack Developer and Computer Science student with a strong interest in building web applications. I work on both Frontend and Backend, creating responsive user interfaces with React and Next.js, and building APIs and server-side systems with Node.js and Express.js.

I believe good software is more than just code. It needs clear structure, good performance, and a great user experience. I enjoy breaking down problems, finding simple solutions, and building applications that are easy to use, maintain, and improve over time.
servicesIntro: From building responsive interfaces to developing APIs and managing databases, I create complete web solutions that work smoothly from Frontend to Backend.
projectsIntro: A look at the projects I've built, the problems I've solved, and the technologies I've used to turn ideas into working applications.

journeyIntro: Every project and new skill has been a step forward. Here's a look at how my journey in web development has grown over time.
journeyEnding: Still learning. Still building. More to come…

journeySteps.title: Built My First Full-Stack Project
journeySteps.body: Built a full-stack accommodation booking platform where guests can explore properties and manage reservations, while hosts can manage their listings and bookings.

journeySteps.title: Started My Web Development Journey
journeySteps.body: Started learning the basics of web development, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, while building my first responsive web pages and small projects.
